- Processing: Fully local

## Transcript

[00:00:10] Riley: This call is to plan the office handover. We are discussing options; nobody is approving a purchase today.

[00:01:00] Sam: We might buy a backup appliance. At my previous company we bought one immediately. That is history, not an order for this office.

[00:03:00] Casey: I think the incoming administrator already has an account, but I have not checked.
